First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, front and rear lights (it's a dark-hours ride), water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before the meet time. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Pace: no-drop, party pace. It's no-drop: if you fall off the back, someone waits. That's the point of a group ride.
Check
Look at @trekbicycleauburn the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Thursday Night Dirtbags group ride

A no-drop gravel ride at a social party pace. It meets at Waverly Local on the first and third Thursdays and at a host's house on the second and fourth. Call the shop for that address. Good for a first gravel group ride.
